description: The line plot illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy of three different methods—On-policy RL (yellow with triangle markers), LUFFY (red with star markers), and SFT (teal with inverted triangle markers)—as a function of generation temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale along the x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), spanning from 62.5 to 80.0 in increments of 2.5. The On-policy RL line begins at approximately 63.0 at temperature 0.1, rises steadily to a peak of 75.0 at 0.8, then declines slightly to 73.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY line starts at 76.0 at 0.1, fluctuates slightly before peaking at 81.0 at 0.8, and stabilizes at 80.0 at 1.0, maintaining the highest accuracy across all temperatures. The SFT line begins at 73.0 at 0.1, drops sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, then recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, exhibiting the most pronounced variability. All three lines show non-monotonic behavior, with LUFFY consistently outperforming the others across the entire temperature range.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates Pass@8 accuracy across varying generation temperatures, measured on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC. The 'On-policy RL' line (yellow, triangle markers) shows a steady increase from approximately 63.0 at 0.1 to 75.0 at 0.8, followed by a slight decline to 73.0 at 1.0. The 'LUFFY' line (red, star markers) demonstrates consistent superiority, starting at 76.0 at 0.1 and peaking at 81.0 at 0.8, before stabilizing at 80.0 at 1.0. The 'SFT' line (teal, inverted triangle markers) begins at 73.0 at 0.1, dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, showing the most variability among the three methods. Overall, LUFFY consistently outperforms the other methods across all temperature settings, with On-policy RL showing the most significant improvement over time.
